thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool eu-west-1-pool-3 experiencing sustained queue growth and 95th pct latency spike. Error rate ~5%. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-pool-congestion :rotating_light:

alex-oncall: I'm on pager. What's current mitigation state?

sasha-sre: investigating. seeing KV cache pressure + a few OOM restarts on gpu-node-7. autoscale at max_replicas=12, burst toggle was off (safety) since 03:20 UTC.

priya-platform: I can enable burst capacity for that pool for short window (up to +10 nodes). Want me to flip now?

alex-oncall: Yes, enable. Also prep a soft per-tenant concurrency cap for top noisy tenants. We'll notify CS.

priya-platform: running command: ```/infra toggle-burst --pool eu-west-1-pool-3 --enable --add-nodes 10 --reason "mitigation - queue surge"```

incident-bot: action: burst toggled ON for eu-west-1-pool-3 by priya-platform at 1745010205. Added 8 nodes (requested 10, autoscaler limited to 8).

dan-eng: applied traffic-shape rule to throttle high-rps clients: ```/config set rate_limit:tenant:{tenant_id} concurrency=20 window=60s``` - applied to 3 tenant ids.

emily-cs: pinging affected customers via status page + direct notes. Draft for status: "We're seeing elevated latency on dedicated pools; mitigation in progress, no data loss. We will follow up." Approve?

alex-oncall: good. post to status, mention potential short disruption to large batch jobs.

priya-platform: toggled off experimental routing for that pool (routing v2 -> v1) to reduce small-model fanout. Command: ```/deploy rollback routing:eu-west-1-pool-3 --to v1```

sasha-sre: metrics: queue depth down 78% in last 7m, 95th latency trending toward baseline. No new OOMs after burst nodes came up. Error rate dropping to 1.2%.

alex-oncall: ok looks stabilizing. Keep burst enabled for 1 hour then scale down to baseline. Leave autoscale limit at max_replicas=20 for now. Document handoff: I'm handing to night shift in 45m. @tony-eng will take over monitoring and finalize scale down.

tony-eng: I got it. Will monitor 30m and then run: ```/infra toggle-burst --pool eu-west-1-pool-3 --disable --drain 5m``` if stable. Also will keep per-tenant caps in place until morning.

sasha-sre: recommendation: keep burst ON + per-tenant concurrency caps for 60–90 minutes, postmortem to include root cause (kv eviction + autoscaler hysteresis). Will collect kernel logs from gpu-node-7 and scheduler metrics.

emily-cs: status update posted. customers notified.

incident-bot: NOTE: mitigation actions recorded. Monitoring for 2h. If any regression, escalate to eng-runtime and oncall immediately.

alex-oncall: thanks team. Handing over now.

tony-eng: taking over — will post final update when burst disabled or if things change. :thumbsup:
